# Scope4C final source-backed architecture model

Architecture mapping only; this is not completed security-audit coverage. Final integration qualification and final deployment/delta evidence were inspected. Source inspected read-only/offline; no app/test execution or source/native/Git/canonical-security mutation by this reviewer.

## summary

Scope4C adds analysis-only CUDA_STATIC and CUDA_INCREMENTAL hypergraph motif jobs to optional CANDY Runtime: browser committed incidence data -> authenticated loopback artifacts/jobs -> frozen qualification transport -> fixed native executable -> validated SHA-bound results. CLI uses default 127.0.0.1:8791; Runtime feature flag defaults off. Production Studio supplies Hypergraph only, so incremental execution is supported through Runtime/trusted fixture callers but unavailable in current production UI without a separate authoritative DynamicHypergraph/pending-update caller (package.json:13; candy-runtime/src/cli.js:6; candy-runtime/src/config.js:31; src/candy/featureFlag.js:1; src/App.jsx:3667; candy-runtime/src/backends/motifJobAdapter.js:8). This is architecture mapping, not completed audit coverage. Final integration evidence reports LIVE_RUNTIME_QUALIFICATION_PASS, LIVE_OLLAMA_QUALIFICATION_PASS and PASS for both frozen native regression replays (artifacts/candy-scope4c-live-runtime-qualification.json:3; artifacts/candy-scope4c-live-ollama-qualification.json:3; artifacts/candy-scope4c-4b1-native-regression.json:3; artifacts/candy-scope4c-4b2-native-regression.json:3). These are qualification evidence, distinct from the independent source-based finding review.

## assets

- Session pairing authority: random 32-byte bearer credential in Runtime memory, CLI writes tmpdir()/candy-runtime-pairing-<pid>.txt with mode 0600; browser persists it in same-origin sessionStorage key hypergraph-studio.candy-runtime-token.session and sends Authorization only to validated HTTP localhost/127.0.0.1 origins (candy-runtime/src/auth/sessionAuth.js:3; candy-runtime/src/cli.js:7; src/candy/useCandyRuntime.js:9; src/candy/client.js:15). Windows ACL/private host directory is an operator prerequisite; POSIX file modes alone do not establish Windows isolation.

- Immutable graph/update/result artifact bytes at <artifactRoot>/<sha256hex>.artifact; default <OS tmpdir>/candy-runtime-artifacts-<random>/, in-memory metadata only. Fixed local qualification records, native binary/source/Makefile and five qualification evidence reports per motif backend protect consistency; records are unsigned local operator attestations rather than publisher signatures (candy-runtime/src/server.js:47; candy-runtime/src/artifacts/artifactStore.js:33; candy-runtime/src/capabilities/motifQualification.js:26; artifacts/candy-scope4c-architecture.md:23).

- GPU/host availability, graph/version/update identity, accepted result semantics and cleanup integrity: private tmpdir()/candy-job-<random>/request.txt; queued jobs and Runtime session UUID in memory; incremental results contain signed delta counts only and do not mutate graph state (candy-runtime/src/jobs/jobManager.js:76; candy-runtime/src/jobs/jobManager.js:159; candy-runtime/src/backends/motifJobAdapter.js:45; src/candy/motifWorkflow.js:16).

- Bounded user queries/observations sent to configured local/private Ollama /api/chat, and qualification reports written under repository artifacts; live Ollama qualification records raw model outputs but transports pairing credentials over private child IPC rather than reporting them (src/agent/localModelClient.js:74; src/agent/localModelClient.js:321; candy-runtime/test/run-scope4c-ollama-qualification.mjs:34; candy-runtime/test/run-scope4c-ollama-qualification.mjs:66).

## trustBoundaries

- Unpaired local callers and browser origins -> Runtime: 127.0.0.1 bind only, exact allowlist localhost:5173/127.0.0.1:5173/https://hypergraphproject.github.io; /v1/health is public, protected routes need bearer token and reject present disallowed Origin. Origin absent is allowed, so bearer authority is the actual non-browser boundary; there is one shared session, no tenant or per-job-owner isolation (candy-runtime/src/config.js:10; candy-runtime/src/server.js:19; candy-runtime/src/server.js:59; candy-runtime/src/server.js:68).

- Paired HTTP caller -> immutable store/job preparation: exact upload/job/request schemas, SHA IDs, digest reread and cardinality/version binding; paired callers supply their own graph data and request snapshots. Browser authority comes from committed workspace, not HTTP server-side ownership claims. Frozen packers derive NEW graph/affected sets/candidates from OLD+update; no client NEW graph or prior counts accepted (candy-runtime/src/server.js:32; candy-runtime/src/artifacts/artifactStore.js:82; candy-runtime/src/jobs/jobManager.js:88; candy-runtime/src/backends/motifJobAdapter.js:8; candy-runtime/test/hypergraph-motif-cuda-incremental-contract.mjs:43).

- Model-generated action -> browser coordinator: strict bounded selectors only, eight-step limit, request-family checks, observed device/update selector rechecks, always-confirm motif action, bound staged arguments/context/session checked before submission. Loopback API itself requires no UI confirmation; credential holders already have job authority (src/candy/motifWorkflow.js:6; src/agent/reactOrchestratorConfig.js:1; src/agent/orchestratorLoop.js:113; src/agent/orchestratorLoop.js:142; src/agent/orchestratorCapabilities.js:112; src/components/AgentChatPanel.jsx:1457; src/components/AgentChatPanel.jsx:2627; src/candy/requestPolicy.js:17).

- Runtime -> operator native files/GPU/WSL: fixed runtimeRoot from source module location, fixed native paths, bounded regular non-symlink hashes and evidence, qualification tags and actual CUDA 13.4/device-0 probes; submission and runner reverify. Linux launches /usr/bin/setsid --wait /bin/bash <fixed supervisor> <binary> <request>; Windows launches wsl.exe -d Ubuntu --exec with drive paths mapped under /mnt/<drive>. Supervisor sends PID before parent CANDY_EXECUTE acknowledgment, then execs fixed arguments; cancellation kills Linux process group and bounds cleanup. It is same operator authority, not a sandbox (candy-runtime/src/config.js:29; candy-runtime/src/capabilities/motifQualification.js:30; candy-runtime/src/capabilities/motifQualification.js:35; candy-runtime/src/backends/nativeProcessRunner.js:43; candy-runtime/src/backends/nativeSupervisor.sh:4).

- Native output -> accepted browser result: bounded stdout/stderr and JSON parsing, frozen semantic/transport validators, exact compiler/runtime/CC checks; Runtime wraps job/session/graph/update/request digest/fingerprint and publishes only completed results after workspace cleanup. Browser requires locally retained job binding, current context/session, native counts metadata and result artifact digest (candy-runtime/src/backends/nativeProcessRunner.js:99; candy-runtime/src/backends/motifJobAdapter.js:27; candy-runtime/src/jobs/jobManager.js:244; src/candy/useCandyRuntime.js:99; src/candy/motifWorkflow.js:35).

- Trusted local startup/test operator -> server configuration: exported startCandyRuntime can override pairing token, allowedOrigins, port, artifactRoot, limits, backend discovery and runner, but these are in-process authority, unavailable through HTTP/model input. CLI has no overrides; live test child uses port 0 and sends credential by IPC. Mock SSSP tests inject runner/backendAvailable and suppress motif discovery unless explicitly injected (candy-runtime/src/config.js:31; candy-runtime/src/server.js:44; candy-runtime/src/capabilities/motifQualification.js:38; candy-runtime/src/capabilities/capabilityRegistry.js:64; candy-runtime/test/scope4c-live-server.mjs:2; tests/candy-scope2-job-engine.test.mjs:22).

- Browser -> optional existing Ollama bridge: standard transports localhost:11434 or 127.0.0.1:8787/ollama. Generic local model client accepts local/private HTTP(S) and activeBaseUrl precedes baseUrl. Bridge has independent Origin controls, no CANDY bearer auth, fixed /api/tags and /api/chat proxy routes, configurable bind/upstream limited to local/private targets; replacing pathname means any configured upstream path prefix is discarded (src/agent/ollamaConnectionManager.js:14; src/agent/localModelClient.js:25; src/agent/localModelClient.js:74; local-runtime-bridge.js:16; local-runtime-bridge.js:34; local-runtime-bridge.js:51; local-runtime-bridge.js:118; local-runtime-bridge.js:216).

## attackerCapabilities

- An unpaired website can issue loopback/browser requests and control its Origin only within browser rules; it lacks the random session token. A local non-browser process can omit/spoof Origin but still lacks bearer authority unless it already can read operator credential storage; don't assume operator account compromise.

- A paired caller can upload bounded incidence/update JSON and select valid jobs, read/cancel session jobs and receive results. It cannot select native paths, shell, environment, WSL distribution or model-provided NEW graph through the Runtime schemas (candy-runtime/src/server.js:32; candy-runtime/src/jobs/jobManager.js:17; src/candy/contracts/runtimeMotif.js:9).

- Untrusted file contents/user text/model replies may influence bounded observations/action proposals. The model has no OS or token authority and can propose only selectors, while coordinator controls confirmation, uploads and graph binding (src/agent/orchestratorLoop.js:113; src/candy/motifWorkflow.js:6).

- Filesystem/build/qualification writers and trusted test override providers already share operator/code execution authority. Hash records establish consistency under trusted-host assumptions, not isolation from malicious operator file modification (artifacts/candy-scope4c-architecture.md:23; candy-runtime/src/capabilities/motifQualification.js:39).

## securityObjectives

- Preserve bearer-plus-present-Origin enforcement and loopback-only Runtime binding; keep session credential out of logs/model observations/reports and recognize same-origin sessionStorage authority (candy-runtime/src/server.js:19; candy-runtime/src/cli.js:7; src/candy/useCandyRuntime.js:9).

- Only exact qualified backend/device and immutable authorized graph/update may execute; STATIC routes CUDA_STATIC and INCREMENTAL CUDA_INCREMENTAL; no CPU/mode fallback, projection, model graph serialization, caller NEW or incremental count reconstruction (src/candy/contracts/runtimeMotif.js:8; src/candy/motifWorkflow.js:6; candy-runtime/src/backends/motifJobAdapter.js:15; candy-runtime/test/hypergraph-motif-cuda-incremental-contract.mjs:56).

- Bound resources: default requests 8 MiB, artifacts 6 MiB, results/stdout 8 MiB, stderr 64 KiB, retained jobs 256; store 512 artifacts/64 MiB; motifs max 256 hyperedges/100000 incidences and 60000 ms, serialized motif queue; exact native packers impose aggregate work envelope. Cancellation/shutdown should suppress accepted results, drain execution, and clean request workspace before terminal publication (candy-runtime/src/config.js:16; candy-runtime/src/artifacts/artifactStore.js:10; candy-runtime/src/jobs/jobManager.js:113; candy-runtime/src/jobs/jobManager.js:244; candy-runtime/src/jobs/jobManager.js:267; candy-runtime/src/capabilities/capabilityRegistry.js:79; candy-runtime/test/hypergraph-motif-cuda-contract.mjs:14).

- Preserve analysis-only results and independently bound browser result acceptance/confirmation. Existing parser run/apply and graph mutation workflows keep separate authority; motif request family cannot authorize them (src/agent/orchestratorLoop.js:124; src/agent/confirmationPolicy.js:19; src/components/AgentChatPanel.jsx:2627; src/candy/useCandyRuntime.js:99).

## assumptions

- Caller-supplied context: both qualified native motif trees and historical qualification harnesses frozen; qualified regression evidence may be read for mapping, but no audit coverage claim follows. No AGENTS.md or SECURITY.md was found by offline repository recursive inventory; guides supplied by parent applied.

- Default OS tmpdir on inspected Windows host is C:/Users/tharu/AppData/Local/Temp, yielding temporary pairing/artifact/job locations stated above; Linux uses its OS tmpdir. Exact random directory suffix/PID is runtime-dependent. Explicit artifactRoot preserves caller-owned root on close, unlike default temp store disposal (candy-runtime/src/server.js:47; candy-runtime/src/server.js:104). Private Windows ACLs, trusted WSL Ubuntu distribution, inherited host environment/PATH and stable operator-owned files are deployment prerequisites.

- Documentation discrepancy resolved in current source: earlier README described OpenMP-only/CUDA-unavailable state; current README explicitly documents all four fixed backends, unsigned local CUDA qualification, explicit Ubuntu supervised execution and production STATIC-only committed Hypergraph eligibility (candy-runtime/README.md:3; candy-runtime/README.md:5; candy-runtime/README.md:14; candy-runtime/README.md:25). The Scope4C architecture artifact remains an initial preimplementation audit by its own status, while final live/regression reports now pass (artifacts/candy-scope4c-architecture.md:58; artifacts/candy-scope4c-live-runtime-qualification.json:3; artifacts/candy-scope4c-live-ollama-qualification.json:3).

- Legacy LOCAL_CUDA SSSP qualification probes select default WSL distro while shared runner and motif probes explicitly select Ubuntu (candy-runtime/src/capabilities/cudaQualification.js:47; candy-runtime/src/capabilities/cudaQualification.js:54; candy-runtime/src/backends/nativeProcessRunner.js:51; candy-runtime/src/capabilities/motifQualification.js:10). Final deployment evidence establishes observed alignment on this host: default distro Ubuntu, WSL version 2, and actual wslListVerbose '* Ubuntu ... 2' (artifacts/candy-scope4c-delta-audit.json:625; artifacts/candy-scope4c-delta-audit.json:626; artifacts/candy-scope4c-delta-audit.json:627). This resolves the missing host-state prerequisite for the reviewed deployment; other hosts still require probe/execution distro alignment.

- Production App constructs the Runtime graph from committed hes, not finalHes preview, explicitly marks Hypergraph and supplies no pendingUpdate; true DynamicHypergraph incremental callers remain conditional API/library or trusted test interfaces. Runtime readiness before graph conversion is independent of graph eligibility (src/App.jsx:3667; src/App.jsx:3673; candy-runtime/README.md:25; src/candy/useCandyRuntime.js:64; src/candy/useCandyRuntime.js:79).

- Final source inspected includes supervisor acknowledgment, serialized motifs, shutdown recheck after awaited discovery, workspace cleanup and motif terminal publication afterward. Qualification reports pass; architecture mapping does not validate vulnerabilities or declare scan coverage. Parent must separately validate findings and reconcile coverage. No app/test execution, external contact, source/native/Git/canonical-security mutation or further delegation occurred during this architecture pass (candy-runtime/src/jobs/jobManager.js:102; candy-runtime/src/jobs/jobManager.js:244; candy-runtime/src/jobs/jobManager.js:262; candy-runtime/src/jobs/jobManager.js:267).

- Native cancellation/timeout assumes a responsive trusted WSL Ubuntu process-control channel. Runner attempts process-group KILL with a bounded retry and eventually rejects/ends its client after timeout+15000 ms; under a broken/disconnected WSL channel, source alone does not prove remote Linux process termination. Passing ordinary qualification cancellation/timeout cases does not settle that failure mode, and the architecture pass did not execute a broken-WSL test (candy-runtime/src/backends/nativeProcessRunner.js:71; candy-runtime/src/backends/nativeProcessRunner.js:79; candy-runtime/src/backends/nativeProcessRunner.js:95).

- Final delta evidence records 54 frozen native/harness/historical paths whose byteEqualToConfiguredCheckout values are all true; Git-blob byte equality is separately false for checkout-normalized files and physicalNativeBytesEqualToGitBaseline is false, so 'unchanged' means exact configured-checkout equality, not byte identity to LF Git blobs (artifacts/candy-scope4c-delta-audit.json:18; artifacts/candy-scope4c-delta-audit.json:25; artifacts/candy-scope4c-delta-audit.json:506; artifacts/candy-scope4c-delta-audit.json:507). Parent-provided context identifies configured CRLF checkout with core.autocrlf=true; this reviewer verified all 54 reported configured-checkout equality flags. The 27 final reviewed-source SHA-256 values at artifacts/candy-scope4c-delta-audit.json:514 were independently compared read-only to current files with zero mismatches, consistent with :624. This binds final architectural facts to current source and does not replace finding validation.
